rows.en:
(School's over, so maybe I'll go have tea
with Nanase or something.)
Yeah. Well then, shall we go?
Mmm~! Tea and cake are delicious too, after all!
rows.notes: x2, Nanase (yappari ... mo: besides Nyan-Nyan's dim sum).

rows.en: Girls sure do love that stuff, huh.

Yes. They don't serve it at Nyan-Nyan,
and it's not something you can whip up at home.
That's true.

Unless I come to a place like this,
I don't really get the chance to have it.

Come to think of it, who else do you go
to places like this with, Nanase?
Let's see~...

Ranka-san, kids from the art department...
Oh, and Saotome-kun, Michel-kun, and so on!
rows.notes: x2, Nanase. bijutsuka 'art department' as c11846 (the Art Course term is geijutsuka).

rows.en: Huh, so you've got friends in the Pilot Course too.

Yes, we worked together on a lot of things for our
junior high graduation project... We've been
friends ever since.
And then there's me... I guess...

That's right. Since starting high school... it's been
over a year now. Do you think people see us
as a couple, sitting together like this?
Well, some people might see it that way...
Oh, no, I didn't mean it like that...
Ahahaha, you don't have to deny it that hard.
Nanase?

Sorry, and I'm the one who brought it up...
I'm... um... not very good with that kind of thing...

But I really like that I can just talk
with you normally like this, \p-kun...
So please keep being a good friend to me, okay?
Of course. Same here, from now on too.
(A good friend, huh. That's not so bad either.)

(School's over, so I'll go have tea
with Nanase or something~)
Yeah. Well then, let's go!
Girls really do love this stuff, right?
That's so true.
Huh, so you've got friends in the Pilot Course too.
And me too!

That's right. Since starting high school... it's been
over a year now. Time sure flies.
It really does.
Please keep being a good friend to me, okay?
Of course! And the same goes for me!
(Nanase really is a sweet girl.)

(Well, class is over, so maybe I'll stop by
Silver Moon with Nanase...)
rows.notes: Male. Trailing blank line (full-width space) dropped as in c11799.

rows.en:
Oh, \p-kun.
Shall we go, then?

Taking a breather like this really is nice,
isn't it?

Yes. I love my art assignments and my job, but
I guess I need a breather too...

I see, you're right.
Balance is key in everything, I guess.
(Nanase seems to give everything her all...)

(Well, class is over, so I'll stop by
Silver Moon with Nanase~)

Oh, \p-san.
Shall we go, then?

I see, that's so true.
Balance is key in everything, I guess.
(Nanase seems to give everything her all, huh...)

(I worked up the nerve to invite Nanase
to the artificial island, but...)

\p-kun,
sorry to keep you waiting!
Oh, looks like you're all fired up, huh?
Huh? N-No, I'm not...
Well, shall we get going?
Wow~ This is amazing. It's just like the real sea.
Yeah, you'd never think we're in the middle of space.
rows.notes: Male; same English as the female c11794.

rows.en: Ahahaha. Well then, shall we go get changed?
Yeah, um... where's a place we can change...
Wh-What's this...
Wh-What a huge line...

Hmm...
Well, I'm a guy, so I can just change
in the shade of a tree, but...

Oh, I'll be fine too!
I wore my swimsuit under my clothes, just in case...
Wow, you came prepared.

Yes.
But... even so, it's still a little embarrassing...
Could you keep watch so nobody peeks?
No problem.
No turning around, okay?
Ahahaha, I won't.
I'll change quickly, so please wait a moment.
Don't worry, I'm keeping watch.
Kyaaah!!
Nanase? What's wrong?
Oh, there's a weird animal over there...
KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!
Uh, sorry about that.

No, it was my fault.
I screamed over such a little thing.
So you're not good with small animals, huh...

Yes...
Well, let's forget about that and have fun, okay?
Yeah, we came all the way to such a nice place!

(I lost all track of time playing...
But it was really fun.)
(I invited Nanase to the artificial island, but...)

\p-san,
sorry to keep you waiting!
Oh, are you all fired up?
Well, whatever. Let's get going!

uncertain: c11723: bijutsuka rendered 'the art department' as in finished c11846; the glossary Art Course is geijutsuka.
c11760/c11792: harikitte iru 'all fired up', matching finished c11801/c11810.
